title: Attack of the Super Battle Droids
front_description: Count Dooku's new battle droids are formidable, state-of-the-art opponents, but the courageous Jedi Knights continue to fight furiously. At one point, Mace Windu faces off with his fiery antagonist from the archducal box, Jango Fett. The two battle, almost to a standstill, until Mace finally gains the upper hand and slashes Jango's helmet off.The bounty hunter's decapitated body falls to the ground.
back_description: Temuera Morrison films Jango's death scene with Samuel L. Jackson.
